reason: The README presents MuseAI primarily as a local AI companion and interactive story application centered on persistent characters, worlds, conversations, and relationship memories; it also includes text adventures, writing tools, external model APIs, and LAN mobile access.

summaries.zh: MuseAI 是一款本地 AI 互动应用，用于创建角色与世界、进行长期角色聊天和文字冒险，并保存相关记忆与关系记录。
summaries.en: MuseAI is a local AI interaction app for creating characters and worlds, engaging in persistent roleplay chats and text adventures, and saving related memories and relationship records.

capabilities: AI roleplay chat with configurable characters and worlds
Text-based adventure and interactive story progression
Local storage of characters, world settings, conversations, and relationship memories
External AI model API configuration and calls
LAN browser access from mobile devices
Story document, outline, and writing analysis tools
